dimensions.correct_and_grounded: 0 invents, contradicts evidence or misses the task; 1 mostly sound; 2 fully sound and evidence-faithful
dimensions.direct_and_concise: 0 evasive or bloated; 1 usable; 2 leads with the answer at the right length
dimensions.natural_and_adaptive: 0 robotic/repetitive; 1 acceptable; 2 fluent and well matched to the user's tone and knowledge
dimensions.usefully_fpl_native: 0 misuses FPL language or forces FPL into an unrelated answer; 1 competent; 2 precise FPL framing that materially helps

instructions: Score A and B independently from 0-2 on every dimension before revealing the key. Mark one pairwise preference or tie. A concise refusal or scope boundary can score 2. Do not reward verbosity, confident unsupported detail or unnecessary tool narration.
